gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve all dynamic webhooks associated with my application to ensure they are correctly configured and functioning.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of dynamic webhooks, including their IDs, URLs, and the events they are subscribed to.

gold.user: As a developer, I need to register a new dynamic webhook for my app to receive notifications about specific events in Jira.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the webhook details and return a confirmation with the newly created webhook ID and status.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to delete an existing webhook that is no longer needed to keep the system clean and efficient.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the webhook and return a success message.

gold.user: As a support engineer, I need to check the list of failed webhooks to troubleshoot issues and ensure that notifications are being sent correctly.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of failed webhooks, including their IDs, error messages, and timestamps of the failures.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to refresh all webhooks to ensure they are up-to-date with the latest configurations and settings.
gold.ideal: The API should process the refresh request and return a success message indicating that the webhooks have been updated.
